Problem Statement:
Create an abstract class Shape with an abstract method calculateArea().1. The Shape class should have calculateArea().2. Implement Circle and Rectangle classes that extend Shape. 
Input Description:
1. The first line contains shape type (circle or rectangle).2. If circle, next line contains radius.3. If rectangle, next two lines contain length and width. 
Output Description:
Print the area of the shape. 
Sample Input:
circle5 
Sample Output:
78.54
